The essay's central thesis — that the call of conscience operates as primordial-ontological epideictic rhetoric — is the volume's most direct BT/Aristotle bridge. Hyde's 2001 monograph 'The Call of Conscience: Heidegger and Levinas, Rhetoric and the Euthanasia Debate' is the long-form treatment.
